## Connect your own AI with unlimited prompts and easy deploy. I just fixed and rebuilt an entire AI automation flow without opening the flow editor once. We have a YouTube script generation pipeline on Serenities. It takes a keyword (or YouTube URLs), generates  an outline, then writes each section with precise word counts. The URL branch was broken. Subtly broken it was jumping straight from transcript cleansing to a single Claude call with no outline step, no section iteration, no word count targeting. Just a raw prompt that guessed at length every time. I asked Claude to check it via MCP. Within seconds it had read the entire flow every node, every edge, every config. - A broken template variable resolving to [undefined] instead of the word count. - The URL branch missing 7 nodes that the keyword branch had. - The MCP help guide serving 5 thin topics with almost no real documentation. Added 7 new nodes to the URL branch (outline prompt, Claude outline generate, JSON cleaner, iterator,. The flow went from broken to production-ready. Not just "ask AI to explain your code." Title: Appto: An iOS app factory that runs on your own AI subscription | Product Hunt
## An iOS app factory that runs on your own AI subscription. Appto is an iOS app factory for your Mac. It finds a niche where apps already make money, comes up with the app, designs and codes it, builds the App Store page with screenshots and ASO copy in every language, fills in App Store Connect and sends it to Apple when you say go. After launch it shows every sale live, answers reviews, tracks keywords and suggests fixes. It runs on your Claude Code or Codex plan, so there are no token bills. I'm not a developer and shipped 10 apps with it. ### I built an iOS app factory and shipped 10 apps with it. Hi, I'm Dmitry, the maker of Appto. I'm not a developer. In July I built myself a factory for iOS apps. It finds a niche where apps already make money, comes up with the app, designs and codes it, makes the App Store page with screenshots and ASO in every language, fills in App Store Connect and sends it to review when I say go. After launch it shows every sale live and answers reviews. Since July it has shipped 10 of my apps, and two more are in Apple review. Appto is that factory for anyone with a Mac. It runs on the Claude Code or Codex plan you already pay for, so there are no token bills. No reviews yetBe the first to leave a review for Appto. In July I built myself a factory for iOS apps, and since then it has shipped 10 of my apps to the App Store. Appto is that factory, packaged so anyone with a Mac can run it. · writes the code, tests it on the simulator and fixes what it finds. · builds the App Store page, screenshots and ASO copy in every language. · fills in App Store Connect, uploads the build and sends it to Apple review when you say go. · after launch, shows every sale the moment it happens, downloads, proceeds and a page score with a to-do list.
